mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mixture of the secretory products of sebaceous and ceruminous glands from the lining of the skin of the external auditory canal."
Cerumen is a mixture of the secretory products of sebaceous and ceruminous glands from the lining of the skin of the external auditory canal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a concave mirror measuring 9 cm in diameter with a central aperture of about 2 cm in diameter."
The head mirror is a concave mirror measuring 9 cm in diameter with a central aperture of about 2 cm in diameter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a subjective sensation of imbalance, where the patient feels that either his surroundings are going round him, or he himself is rotating."
Vertigo Vertigo or giddiness is a subjective sensation of imbalance, where the patient feels that either his surroundings are going round him, or he himself is rotating.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for syringing to remove impacted wax and certain foreign bodies from external auditory canal (EAC)."
An aural syringe is used for syringing to remove impacted wax and certain foreign bodies from external auditory canal (EAC).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bag like structure containing squamous epithelium and debris resting on a fibrous tissue stroma, usually in the attic, antrum, middle ear and mastoid with a property of eroding bone."

Cholesteatoma is a bag like structure containing squamous epithelium and debris resting on a fibrous tissue stroma, usually in the attic, antrum, middle ear and mastoid with a property of eroding bone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for anterior nasal packing and foreign body removal."
Tilley's nasal dressing forceps is used for anterior nasal packing and foreign body removal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most frequently infected paranasal sinus."
The maxillary sinus is the most frequently infected paranasal sinus.
